name: Canada Postdoctoral Research Award (CPRA)
funder: Government of Canada tri-agency (CIHR, NSERC, SSHRC)
other_rules: Doctorate completed no more than 3 years before 1 September of the application year (extensions for career interruptions, caregiving, industry work, clinical training)
non-Canadians must have a Canadian doctorate or be doing postdoc research at a Canadian institution at the deadline (up to 20% of awards)
held abroad only by Canadian citizens/PRs with a Canadian doctorate
no previous tri-agency postdoc award or Banting
notes: Replaces the Banting Postdoctoral Fellowship and the separate CIHR, NSERC and SSHRC postdoctoral fellowships (Banting's last competition was 2024). Deadline not shown on the NSERC page; usually in autumn, with earlier internal institutional deadlines. Results by 31 March.
